name: Ivy League Heptagonal Cross Country Championships
headline: Ivy League Heptagonal Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Harvard won the men's Heps title with 23 points to Cornell's 53, and Harvard's Tam Gavenas won the 8K in 22:56.8. Princeton won the women's title with 33 points to Penn's 72, while Penn's Allison Lee won the 6K in 20:14.0.
